name: memoryatoms
description: Atomic memory for Claude Code: puts the memory cards that fit your prompt in front of Claude, writes and searches cards through an MCP server, and harvests what a session learned into new cards.

data_dir.title: Data folder
data_dir.description: Where your cards, indexes and logs are kept. Default ~/.memoryatoms. If you are moving from the git install, enter ~/.claude.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of hints and messages: en or zh-TW. Cards are never translated.

python.title: Python interpreter
python.description: Path to Python 3.10 or newer. Leave empty to find it automatically.

remote_llm_user.title: Remote LLM user
remote_llm_user.description: Login name for a remote LLM backend that needs one (vector_search.ollama_backends.<name>.auth in workflow/config.json). Leave empty when you use only the local Ollama.

remote_llm_password.title: Remote LLM password
remote_llm_password.description: Password for that remote LLM backend. Kept in your system's secure credential store, not in settings.json. Leave empty when you use only the local Ollama.
